description: PQC Migration Tool — Quantum-Vulnerable Cryptographic Function Database. Libraries: openssl, cryptopp, gost_openssl.

functions.name: RSA_generate_key_ex
functions.description: Generates an RSA key pair. RSA is fully broken by Shor's algorithm on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. Any key generated with this function provides no post-quantum security.
functions.tc26_reference: Рекомендации ТК 26 по переходу на постквантовые алгоритмы: RSA подлежит замене. См. методические рекомендации по применению ГОСТ Р 34.12.

replacements.notes: Use NIST PQC ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber) for key encapsulation, or ML-DSA for signing.
replacements.migration_notes: Replace RSA_generate_key_ex with EVP_PKEY_keygen backed by oqsprovider ML-KEM-768 context.

functions.name: OBJ_txt2nid
functions.description: Text-to-NID conversion for Russian GOST/TC26 algorithm identifiers. Indicates that the code uses GOST cryptography.

functions.name: RSA_public_encrypt
functions.description: Performs raw RSA public-key encryption or decryption. Directly vulnerable to Shor's algorithm. These low-level RSA functions bypass the EVP abstraction layer and should be considered deprecated.
functions.tc26_reference: Согласно рекомендациям ТК 26, использование RSA для шифрования данных не соответствует требованиям постквантовой стойкости.

replacements.notes: Switch to NIST-standardised ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for key encapsulation.

functions.name: RSA_sign
functions.description: Low-level RSA signing and verification. Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm. Both RSA-PKCS1 and RSA-PSS schemes built on RSA arithmetic are quantum-insecure.
functions.nist_reference: NIST FIPS 186-5 (deprecated RSA for post-quantum context); NISTIR 8413
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26 рекомендует замену RSA-подписи на ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 (краткосрочно) и постквантовые схемы подписи (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) в долгосрочной перспективе.

replacements.notes: Use ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) via oqsprovider.

functions.name: DSA_sign
functions.description: Low-level DSA signing and verification using the Digital Signature Algorithm. DSA security relies on the discrete logarithm problem, which is efficiently solved by Shor's algorithm on a quantum computer.
functions.tc26_reference: Алгоритм DSA не включён в перечень алгоритмов, рекомендованных ТК 26 для долгосрочного использования в условиях квантовых угроз.

replacements.notes: Migrate to ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium, FIPS 204) via oqsprovider.

functions.name: DH_generate_key
functions.description: Performs finite-field Diffie-Hellman key generation and shared-secret computation. The discrete logarithm problem underlying DH is solved in polynomial time by Shor's algorithm on a sufficiently powerful quantum computer.
functions.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-56A Rev.3; NIST SP 800-131A Rev.2
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: протокол Диффи-Хеллмана на конечных полях уязвим к квантовым атакам; рекомендуется переход на механизмы инкапсуляции ключей (КЕМ) на постквантовых схемах.

replacements.notes: Replace DH key exchange with ML-KEM (FIPS 203) key encapsulation.

functions.name: ECDH_compute_key
functions.description: Computes a shared ECDH secret directly. The elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem (ECDLP) on which ECDH relies is solved in polynomial time by Shor's algorithm on a quantum computer.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ECDH и аналогичные протоколы на эллиптических кривых теряют стойкость при наличии квантового компьютера; замена на постквантовые КЕМ обязательна.

replacements.notes: Use ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber, FIPS 203) instead of ECDH.

functions.name: ECDSA_sign
functions.description: Low-level ECDSA signing and verification. ECDSA security is based on the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem, which is broken by Shor's algorithm on a quantum computer.
functions.nist_reference: NIST FIPS 186-5 (ECDSA retained for now but not quantum-safe); NISTIR 8413
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ECDSA (и аналог — ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012) не обеспечивает постквантовую стойкость; необходим переход на ML-DSA или SLH-DSA.

replacements.notes: Use ML-DSA (FIPS 204) via oqsprovider for post-quantum signatures.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_keygen
functions.description: High-level EVP key generation function. Emit a warning when the associated EVP_PKEY_CTX was initialised with quantum-vulnerable algorithms such as RSA, EC, DH, or DSA. Suppress the warning when the argument chain shows a PQC-safe context created from names like "ML-KEM-*", "ML-DSA-*", "SLH-DSA-*" or other post-quantum algorithms.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: генерация ключей через EVP_PKEY_keygen для RSA/EC/DH не обеспечивает постквантовую стойкость; необходима замена на постквантовые алгоритмы через oqsprovider.

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_keygen with ML-KEM or ML-DSA context
replacements.notes: Load oqsprovider and initialise EVP_PKEY_CTX with 'ML-KEM-768', 'ML-DSA-65', or similar PQC algorithm names before calling EVP_PKEY_keygen.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignInit
functions.description: Initialises a digest-sign operation. When used with an RSA, ECDSA, or DSA private key, the resulting signature scheme is quantum-insecure. Vulnerability is conditional on the key type loaded into the EVP_MD_CTX.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: инициализация подписи через EVP_DigestSignInit с ключами RSA/EC/DSA не обеспечивает постквантовую стойкость.

replacements.function: EVP_DigestSignInit with ML-DSA or SLH-DSA key
replacements.notes: Load oqsprovider, generate an ML-DSA key, and pass it to EVP_DigestSignInit.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new
functions.description: Creates a new EVP_PKEY_CTX from an existing EVP_PKEY object. If the key is RSA, EC, DH, or DSA, all subsequent operations using this context are quantum-insecure.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: создание контекста для квантово-уязвимых ключей (RSA/EC/DH/DSA) не соответствует требованиям постквантовой стойкости.

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new with a PQC key (ML-KEM, ML-DSA)
replacements.notes: Ensure the EVP_PKEY passed to EVP_PKEY_CTX_new is a post-quantum key generated via oqsprovider.

functions.name: DH_new
functions.description: Allocates a new DH structure used for finite-field Diffie-Hellman operations. Merely allocating this structure signals intent to use a quantum-vulnerable key-exchange algorithm.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: структуры DH относятся к квантово-уязвимым примитивам; необходима замена на постквантовые КЕМ.

replacements.notes: Replace DH structures with ML-KEM key pairs via oqsprovider.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_id
functions.description: Creates a new EVP_PKEY_CTX by numeric algorithm identifier. Emit a warning only when the resolved first argument indicates a classical vulnerable algorithm such as EVP_PKEY_RSA, EVP_PKEY_DSA, EVP_PKEY_DH, EVP_PKEY_EC, or their numeric NID forms 6, 116, 28, 408.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: вызов EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_id с идентификаторами алгоритмов RSA, DSA, DH или EC (NID 6, 116, 28, 408 соответственно) создаёт контекст для квантово-уязвимого примитива; рекомендуется переход на постквантовые алгоритмы через oqsprovider.

replacements.notes: In OpenSSL 3.x with oqsprovider loaded, use EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name with PQC algorithm names such as 'ML-KEM-768', 'ML-DSA-65', 'SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s' instead of numeric NIDs.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name
functions.description: OpenSSL 3.x API that creates an EVP_PKEY_CTX from a string algorithm name. Emit a warning when resolved arguments contain classical algorithm literals such as "RSA", "EC", "DSA", "DH", "X25519", "X448", "ED25519", or "ED448". Suppress the warning when resolved arguments contain PQC-safe algorithm literals such as "ML-KEM-*", "ML-DSA-*", "SLH-DSA-*", or other PQC names propagated through the argument chain.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name с именами RSA/EC/DSA/DH/X25519/X448 является квантово-уязвимым; при использовании имён ML-KEM-*/ML-DSA-*/SLH-DSA-* уязвимость отсутствует.

replacements.notes: When using OpenSSL 3.x with oqsprovider, replace classical algorithm name strings with PQC equivalents such as 'ML-KEM-768', 'ML-DSA-65', or 'SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s'.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignUpdate
functions.description: Feeds data into a streaming digest-sign operation. Used in conjunction with EVP_DigestSignInit and EVP_DigestSignFinal to produce a digital signature. When the underlying key is RSA, ECDSA, or DSA (configured via EVP_DigestSignInit), the signature is quantum-insecure. Vulnerability is inherited from the key type set in the EVP_MD_CTX.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: EVP_DigestSignUpdate используется в составе механизма подписи; при использовании ключей RSA/EC/DSA операция является квантово-уязвимой.

replacements.function: EVP_DigestSignUpdate with ML-DSA or SLH-DSA key context
replacements.notes: No API change required; replace the underlying key with a PQC key (ML-DSA / SLH-DSA) initialised via oqsprovider.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignFinal
functions.description: Finalises a streaming digest-sign operation, producing the signature bytes. Used after EVP_DigestSignInit and EVP_DigestSignUpdate. Quantum vulnerability is inherited from the key type: RSA, ECDSA, and DSA contexts produce quantum-insecure signatures. EVP_DigestSign is the one-shot variant and carries the same risk.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: EVP_DigestSignFinal завершает формирование подписи; при ключах RSA/EC/DSA результат является квантово-уязвимым.

replacements.function: EVP_DigestSignFinal / EVP_DigestSign with ML-DSA or SLH-DSA key
replacements.notes: Replace key material with a post-quantum key; the EVP API itself remains unchanged.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyInit
functions.description: Initialises a digest-verify operation using an EVP_PKEY public key. When the public key is RSA, ECDSA, or DSA, the verification accepts signatures that are quantum-insecure. An attacker with a quantum computer could forge valid signatures for these key types.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: инициализация проверки подписи EVP_DigestVerifyInit с ключами RSA/EC/DSA не обеспечивает постквантовую стойкость проверки.

replacements.function: EVP_DigestVerifyInit with ML-DSA or SLH-DSA public key
replacements.notes: Use a PQC public key (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) from oqsprovider; the EVP API call pattern remains identical.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate
functions.description: Feeds data into a streaming digest-verify operation. Used together with EVP_DigestVerifyInit and EVP_DigestVerifyFinal. Quantum vulnerability is inherited from the key type configured in the EVP_MD_CTX via EVP_DigestVerifyInit.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate используется в составе процедуры верификации подписи; при ключах RSA/EC/DSA операция является квантово-уязвимой.

replacements.function: EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate with ML-DSA or SLH-DSA key context
replacements.notes: No API change required; replace underlying public key with a PQC key.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyFinal
functions.description: Finalises a streaming digest-verify operation. Used after EVP_DigestVerifyInit and EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate to verify a digital signature. EVP_DigestVerify is the one-shot equivalent. Both are quantum-insecure when the public key is RSA, ECDSA, or DSA, as Shor's algorithm allows forgery of signatures for these key types.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: EVP_DigestVerifyFinal завершает проверку подписи; при ключах RSA/EC/DSA результат является квантово-уязвимым.

replacements.function: EVP_DigestVerifyFinal / EVP_DigestVerify with ML-DSA or SLH-DSA public key
replacements.notes: Replace key material with a post-quantum public key; the EVP call pattern remains unchanged.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_derive_init
functions.description: Initialises a key derivation operation in an EVP_PKEY_CTX. Typically used to set up ECDH or finite-field DH shared-secret derivation. When the context was created from an EC or DH key, the derivation is quantum-insecure because Shor's algorithm solves the underlying discrete logarithm / elliptic-curve discrete logarithm problem.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: EVP_PKEY_derive_init для ECDH/DH контекстов является квантово-уязвимой операцией; рекомендуется переход на ML-KEM.

replacements.notes: Replace ECDH/DH key derivation with ML-KEM (FIPS 203) key encapsulation mechanism via oqsprovider.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer
functions.description: Sets the peer public key in an EVP_PKEY_CTX for ECDH or DH key derivation. This is a required step in the ECDH/DH shared-secret protocol, which is fully broken by Shor's algorithm on a quantum computer. The presence of this call reliably indicates quantum-vulnerable key exchange is being performed.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: установка ключа партнёра через EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer для ECDH/DH является квантово-уязвимой операцией.

replacements.notes: In ML-KEM there is no peer-key concept; use encapsulate/decapsulate instead of derive.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_derive
functions.description: Performs the final step of EVP-level ECDH or DH key derivation, computing the shared secret. This function is the culmination of a quantum-insecure key-agreement operation. An attacker with a cryptographically relevant quantum computer can reproduce the shared secret using Shor's algorithm applied to the exchanged public keys.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: вычисление общего секрета через EVP_PKEY_derive для ECDH/DH является квантово-уязвимой операцией; замена на ML-KEM обязательна при долгосрочной защите данных.

replacements.notes: Replace the derive-based ECDH/DH pattern (derive_init → derive_set_peer → derive) with ML-KEM encapsulate/decapsulate.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init
functions.description: Initialises domain-parameter generation in an EVP_PKEY_CTX. Used to generate DH or DSA domain parameters before key generation. Parameter generation for quantum-vulnerable algorithms (DH, DSA, EC) produces parameters that will result in quantum-insecure keys.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: генерация параметров через EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init для DH/DSA/EC является квантово-уязвимой операцией.

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_keygen (ML-KEM or ML-DSA, no separate paramgen step needed)
replacements.notes: PQC algorithms in oqsprovider do not require separate domain-parameter generation; use EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name + EVP_PKEY_keygen directly.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_paramgen
functions.description: Generates domain parameters (e.g., DH group or DSA parameters) using a previously initialised EVP_PKEY_CTX. Parameters generated for DH, DSA, or EC algorithms are quantum-insecure; any keys subsequently generated from these parameters will be vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: параметры, сгенерированные EVP_PKEY_paramgen для DH/DSA/EC, используются для квантово-уязвимых алгоритмов.

replacements.notes: Post-quantum algorithms do not use domain parameters in the classical sense; call EVP_PKEY_keygen directly with a PQC context.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_keygen_init
functions.description: Initialises a key-generation operation in an EVP_PKEY_CTX. Emit a warning when the associated context was created for classical algorithms such as RSA, EC, DH, or DSA. Suppress the warning when the argument chain shows a PQC-safe context created from names like "ML-KEM-*", "ML-DSA-*", "SLH-DSA-*" or other post-quantum algorithms.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: инициализация генерации ключа EVP_PKEY_keygen_init для RSA/EC/DH/DSA является квантово-уязвимой операцией.

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_keygen_init with ML-KEM or ML-DSA context from EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name
replacements.notes: Create the context with a PQC algorithm name (e.g. 'ML-KEM-768') before calling EVP_PKEY_keygen_init.

functions.name: BN_new
functions.description: Allocates a new BIGNUM structure. The presence of BN_new is a red flag for manual large-integer arithmetic, which almost universally indicates a hand-rolled implementation of RSA, DH, or DSA. These custom implementations are quantum-insecure for the same reasons as their OpenSSL high-level counterparts: Shor's algorithm breaks the underlying integer factorisation and discrete logarithm problems. While BN_new itself is not intrinsically tied to a specific algorithm, it should trigger review of the surrounding code for quantum-vulnerable cryptographic constructs.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: использование структур BIGNUM является индикатором ручной реализации криптографических примитивов (RSA/DH/DSA), которые уязвимы к квантовым атакам.

replacements.function: Use high-level EVP API with PQC keys; avoid manual BIGNUM arithmetic
replacements.notes: If BN_* usage implements RSA/DH/DSA, migrate the entire subsystem to oqsprovider. There is no BIGNUM-level equivalent for PQC algorithms.

functions.name: BN_generate_prime_ex
functions.description: Generates a large prime number using BIGNUM arithmetic. Prime generation is a foundational step in RSA key generation (p and q primes) and DSA/DH parameter generation. Its presence strongly indicates manual implementation of RSA or DSA, both of which are quantum-insecure. Shor's algorithm factors the resulting RSA modulus or solves the DSA discrete logarithm in polynomial time on a quantum computer.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: генерация простых чисел через BN_generate_prime_ex характерна для ручной реализации RSA/DSA — алгоритмов, уязвимых к квантовым атакам.

replacements.function: Replace manual RSA/DSA key generation with EVP_PKEY_keygen using ML-KEM or ML-DSA context
replacements.notes: PQC algorithms do not require prime generation; eliminate this code path entirely.

functions.name: BN_mod_exp
functions.description: Computes modular exponentiation (a^p mod m) using BIGNUM arithmetic. Modular exponentiation is the core operation in RSA encryption/decryption, RSA signing, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and DSA. Its presence is a strong indicator of quantum-vulnerable asymmetric cryptography. Shor's algorithm exploits the mathematical properties of modular exponentiation to factor RSA moduli and solve discrete logarithm problems in polynomial time.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: модульное возведение в степень через BN_mod_exp является ключевой операцией RSA/DH/DSA — алгоритмов, уязвимых к атаке алгоритмом Шора.

replacements.function: Eliminate modular exponentiation; use PQC algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) that do not rely on this operation
replacements.notes: If modular exponentiation is part of a custom RSA/DH implementation, the entire cryptographic subsystem should be replaced with oqsprovider-backed PQC primitives.

functions.name: BN_mod_inverse
functions.description: Computes the modular multiplicative inverse. Used in RSA key generation (computing private exponent d = e^-1 mod λ(n)) and in DSA/ECDSA signature generation. The presence of BN_mod_inverse is a reliable indicator of manual RSA or DSA implementation, both of which are quantum-insecure.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: вычисление обратного элемента по модулю через BN_mod_inverse используется в ручных реализациях RSA/DSA — квантово-уязвимых алгоритмов.

replacements.function: Eliminate manual RSA/DSA key arithmetic; use EVP_PKEY_keygen with ML-KEM or ML-DSA
replacements.notes: BN_mod_inverse in a key-generation context is a sign of hand-rolled RSA; migrate the entire component to oqsprovider.

functions.name: BN_GENCB
functions.description: BN_GENCB is a callback structure used to monitor progress during large-prime or parameter generation (typically RSA or DSA key generation). Its presence in code strongly indicates a manual or low-level implementation of RSA or DSA key generation, both of which produce quantum-insecure keys. The associated functions BN_GENCB_new, BN_GENCB_set, and BN_GENCB_call are all indicators of this pattern.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: использование BN_GENCB характерно для ручной генерации ключей RSA/DSA — квантово-уязвимых алгоритмов.

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_keygen with ML-KEM or ML-DSA context (no progress callback needed)
replacements.notes: PQC key generation is fast and does not require progress callbacks; eliminate BN_GENCB usage by migrating to oqsprovider.

functions.name: RSA_new
functions.description: Allocates a new RSA structure for low-level RSA operations. The RSA structure is the foundation for quantum-vulnerable RSA cryptography. Any code using RSA_new is performing or preparing to perform RSA operations that are broken by Shor's algorithm.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: выделение структуры RSA через RSA_new является индикатором использования квантово-уязвимого алгоритма RSA.

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_keygen with ML-KEM or ML-DSA context
replacements.notes: Eliminate low-level RSA_* usage entirely; use the EVP layer with oqsprovider PQC keys.

functions.name: DSA_new
functions.description: Allocates a new DSA structure for low-level Digital Signature Algorithm operations. DSA security relies on the discrete logarithm problem, which is solved in polynomial time by Shor's algorithm. Any code allocating a DSA structure is preparing to use a quantum-insecure signature scheme.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: структура DSA, создаваемая через DSA_new, относится к квантово-уязвимым примитивам; рекомендуется переход на ML-DSA.

replacements.notes: Replace DSA_new and all associated DSA_* low-level calls with the EVP layer backed by oqsprovider ML-DSA.

functions.name: EC_KEY_new
functions.description: Allocates a new EC_KEY structure for low-level elliptic curve cryptography operations (ECDSA, ECDH). The elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem (ECDLP) is solved in polynomial time by Shor's algorithm on a quantum computer, rendering all EC-based keys quantum-insecure. EC_KEY_new_by_curve_name additionally specifies the curve at allocation time.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: структуры EC_KEY используются для ECDSA и ECDH — алгоритмов, уязвимых к квантовым атакам (задача ECDLP решается алгоритмом Шора).

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_keygen with ML-DSA context (signatures) or ML-KEM context (key exchange)
replacements.notes: Eliminate low-level EC_KEY_* usage; use the EVP layer with oqsprovider for PQC operations.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_new_by_curve_name
functions.description: Creates a new elliptic curve group from a named curve NID (e.g., NID_X9_62_prime256v1, NID_secp384r1, NID_secp521r1). All named NIST curves are quantum-insecure: their security depends on the ECDLP, which Shor's algorithm solves efficiently. This function is typically the first step in constructing an EC_KEY for ECDSA signing or ECDH key exchange.
functions.nist_reference: NISTIR 8413; NIST SP 800-186 (elliptic curves for pre-quantum use only)
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: создание группы эллиптической кривой через EC_GROUP_new_by_curve_name — индикатор использования ECDSA/ECDH; все именованные кривые уязвимы к квантовым атакам.

replacements.function: EVP_PKEY_keygen with ML-KEM or ML-DSA context (no EC group needed)
replacements.notes: PQC algorithms do not use elliptic curve groups; eliminate EC_GROUP_* usage by migrating to oqsprovider.

functions.name: SHA1
functions.description: SHA-1 produces a 160-bit digest. While not directly broken by Shor's algorithm, Grover's algorithm reduces its effective security to ~80 bits against preimage attacks, falling below the 128-bit minimum recommended by NIST SP 800-57. SHA-1 has also been practically broken for collision resistance (SHAttered, 2017).
functions.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-131A Rev.2 (SHA-1 disallowed for digital signatures after 2013); NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev.5
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: SHA-1 не рекомендован; для хэширования следует использовать Стрибог (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012) с длиной дайджеста 256 или 512 бит.

replacements.migration_notes: Replace SHA-1 with SHA-256 or SHA-3-256 at minimum. For PQC contexts where Grover's algorithm halves security, prefer SHA-512 or SHA3-512.

functions.name: MD5
functions.description: MD5 produces a 128-bit digest. Collision resistance is completely broken (classical attacks); Grover's algorithm further reduces preimage resistance to ~64 bits. MD5 must not be used for any security-sensitive purpose.
functions.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-131A Rev.2 (MD5 disallowed); NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev.5
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: MD5 не рекомендован для применения в криптографических протоколах; следует использовать Стрибог (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012).

replacements.migration_notes: Replace MD5 with SHA-256 or SHA-3-256. MD5 is broken for collision resistance and must not be used in any security context.

functions.name: RSA::PrivateKey
functions.description: Crypto++ RSA key classes. RSA broken by Shor's algorithm.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: RSA не в ГОСТ-профилях

replacements.migration_notes: Replace Crypto++ RSA with liboqs ML-KEM.

functions.name: RSAES_OAEP_SHA_Encryptor
functions.description: Crypto++ RSA-OAEP encryption. Vulnerable to Shor's (HNDL risk).
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: HNDL-угроза критична для долгосрочных данных

replacements.example_code: OQS_KEM_encaps(kem, ct, ss, pk); // use ss as symmetric key

functions.name: ECDH
functions.description: Crypto++ ECDH. ECDLP broken by Shor's.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: см. VKO ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012

replacements.example_code:
OQS_KEM *kem = OQS_KEM_new(OQS_KEM_alg_ml_kem_768);
OQS_KEM_encaps(kem, ct, ss, pk);

functions.name: ECDSA
functions.description: Crypto++ ECDSA signatures. ECDLP → Shor's.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: аналог — ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012, тоже уязвим

functions.name: DH2
functions.description: Crypto++ Diffie-Hellman. DLP in Zp* → Shor's.

functions.name: gost_ec_sign
functions.description: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 ЭЦП на эллиптических кривых (256/512 бит). Задача дискретного логарифмирования на ЭК решается алгоритмом Шора за полиномиальное время.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 квантово-уязвим через ЗАДЛП; в переходный период — гибрид ГОСТ + ML-DSA-65

replacements.migration_notes: Гибридная схема: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 + ML-DSA-65. Объединять подписи через конкатенацию и раздельную верификацию.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: гибридная подпись ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 + ML-DSA-65 обязательна в переходный период

functions.name: VKO_cryptopro_2001
functions.description: Протокол выработки общего ключа (VKO) на основе ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012. Основан на ЗАДЛП на ЭК — уязвим к алгоритму Шора.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: протокол VKO подлежит замене; гибридный KEM: VKO + ML-KEM-768 через КРФ (HKDF)

replacements.migration_notes: Гибридный KEM: вычислить VKO (классический), вычислить ML-KEM shared_secret, объединить через HKDF.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: гибридный KEM обязателен в переходный период 2025–2030

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name (gost2012/gost2001)
functions.description: Creates an EVP_PKEY_CTX for ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 or ГОСТ Р 34.10-2001 key operations via the OpenSSL 3.x provider API. The algorithm name strings 'gost2012_256', 'gost2012_512', and 'gost2001' identify ECC-based ГОСТ keys. The elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem on ГОСТ TC26 curves is solved in polynomial time by Shor's algorithm, making all keys and signatures produced in this context quantum-insecure. Similarly, EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_id with NID_id_GostR3410_2012_256, NID_id_GostR3410_2012_512, or NID_id_GostR3410_2001 creates the same quantum-vulnerable context.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 квантово-уязвим через ЗАДЛП на ЭК алгебраической группы; в переходный период 2025–2030 рекомендуется гибридная схема ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 + ML-DSA-65.

replacements.migration_notes: Гибридная схема: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 + ML-DSA-65. Заменить алгоритм с "gost2012_256" на "ML-DSA-65" через oqsprovider, сохранив ГОСТ-подпись для совместимости в переходный период.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: гибридная подпись ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 + ML-DSA-65 обязательна в переходный период

functions.name: SSL_CTX_set_cipher_list (GOST суites)
functions.description: Configures OpenSSL TLS context to use ГОСТ cipher suites (e.g. GOST2012-GOST8912-GOST8912, GOST2012-NULL-GOST12). ГОСТ TLS cipher suites defined in RFC 9058 / GOST R TLS use ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 ECC for key exchange (VKO) and authentication. The ECDLP underlying ГОСТ 34.10-2012 is solved in polynomial time by Shor's algorithm. Any TLS session negotiated with a ГОСТ cipher suite is quantum-insecure because the session key establishment relies on a quantum-vulnerable key agreement.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: TLS-сессии с шифрсьютами ГОСТ 34.10-2012 квантово-уязвимы; необходим переход на гибридные KEM (ML-KEM-768 + VKO) в TLS 1.3 с HKDF-комбинацией.

replacements.notes: Переход на TLS 1.3 с гибридными группами: ML-KEM-768 + ECDH/VKO через HKDF-комбинацию. Аутентификация: гибридная подпись ML-DSA-65 + ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: гибридный TLS 1.3 с ML-KEM + VKO обязателен для новых систем с 2025 г.

libgcrypt.description: GNU libgcrypt — низкоуровневая криптографическая библиотека. Используется в GnuPG, NSS и ряде российских продуктов для реализации ГОСТ-алгоритмов (Магма, Кузнечик, Стрибог).

functions.name: gcry_cipher_open
functions.description: Opens a libgcrypt cipher context for a GOST symmetric cipher. GCRY_CIPHER_GOST28147 (Магма, 64-bit block) should be migrated to GCRY_CIPHER_GRASSHOPPER (Кузнечик, 128-bit block). Both are quantum-safe from a key-security perspective (Grover leaves ~128-bit effective security), but Магма has a birthday-bound at 2^32 blocks (~32 GB) due to the 64-bit block size.
functions.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev.5; Grover's algorithm halves symmetric key security
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: Магма (ГОСТ Р 34.12-2015) — 64-битный блок; для новых систем рекомендуется Кузнечик (128-битный блок). Оба алгоритма постквантово-стойки при 256-битном ключе.

replacements.notes: Заменить GCRY_CIPHER_GOST28147 на GCRY_CIPHER_GRASSHOPPER (Кузнечик, ГОСТ Р 34.12-2015): 128-битный блок, 256-битный ключ. Поддерживается в libgcrypt >= 1.8.0.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: Кузнечик (ГОСТ Р 34.12-2015) — рекомендуемый блочный шифр для новых систем

functions.name: gcry_md_open
functions.description: Opens a libgcrypt message digest context for a GOST hash function. GCRY_MD_GOSTR3411_CP/94 is deprecated — must migrate to Стрибог. GCRY_MD_STRIBOG256 provides ~128-bit quantum security (boundary); GCRY_MD_STRIBOG512 provides ~256-bit and is preferred for long-term use.
functions.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-131A Rev.2 (deprecated algorithms); NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev.5
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ГОСТ Р 34.11-94 снят с применения; необходимо перейти на Стрибог-256 или Стрибог-512 (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012).

replacements.notes: Заменить GCRY_MD_GOSTR3411_CP/94 на GCRY_MD_STRIBOG512 (или GCRY_MD_STRIBOG256 при ограничениях размера). ГОСТ Р 34.11-94 снят с применения с 2013 года.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: переход на Стрибог (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012) обязателен

functions.name: gcry_mac_open
functions.description: Opens a libgcrypt MAC context for a GOST MAC algorithm. GCRY_MAC_GOST28147_IMIT (32-bit tag, classical birthday risk at 2^16) should migrate to HMAC-Стрибог. GCRY_MAC_HMAC_STRIBOG256 is acceptable; GCRY_MAC_HMAC_STRIBOG512 is preferred for long-term security.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: имитовставка ГОСТ 28147-89 — 32-битный тег; рекомендуется переход на HMAC-Стрибог-256 (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012) или имитовставку Кузнечика (ГОСТ Р 34.13-2015).

replacements.notes: Заменить GCRY_MAC_GOST28147_IMIT на GCRY_MAC_HMAC_STRIBOG256. Для долгосрочной защиты использовать GCRY_MAC_HMAC_STRIBOG512.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: HMAC-Стрибог является рекомендуемым MAC на основе ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012

functions.name: hmac_streebog256
functions.description: User-defined wrapper function over HMAC-Стрибог-256. HMAC-Стрибог-256 provides ~128-bit quantum security (Grover on Стрибог-256 inner hash). Acceptable for most post-quantum use cases but at the boundary. Flagged for inventory.
functions.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev.5; NIST SP 800-107 Rev.1
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: HMAC-Стрибог-256 обеспечивает 128-битную постквантовую стойкость.

replacements.notes: Для долгосрочной постквантовой защиты заменить на HMAC-Стрибог-512 (256-битная постквантовая стойкость).

functions.name: hmac_streebog512
functions.description: User-defined wrapper function over HMAC-Стрибог-512. Provides ~256-bit quantum security. This is the strongest ГОСТ-standardised MAC construction and is considered quantum-safe. Flagged for inventory purposes only.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: HMAC-Стрибог-512 является постквантово-стойким MAC.

replacements.notes: HMAC-Стрибог-512 уже является постквантово-стойким MAC. Дополнительная миграция не требуется.

functions.name: gost28147_mac
functions.description: User-defined wrapper for GOST 28147-89 MAC (имитовставка). 32-bit authentication tag with birthday-attack risk at 2^16 attempts. Should be migrated to HMAC-Стрибог-256 or Кузнечик MAC (ГОСТ Р 34.13-2015 § 5.7).
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: имитовставка ГОСТ 28147-89 — 32-битный тег; рекомендуется переход на HMAC-Стрибог-256.

replacements.notes: Заменить на HMAC-Стрибог-256 (gcry_mac_open с GCRY_MAC_HMAC_STRIBOG256) или имитовставку Кузнечика.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: переход на HMAC-Стрибог обязателен для новых систем

nettle.description: GNU Nettle — низкоуровневая криптографическая библиотека C. Включает реализации ГОСТ-алгоритмов: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 (gostdsa), Стрибог (streebog), ГОСТ 28147-89 (gost28147).

functions.name: gostdsa_sign
functions.description: Computes or verifies a ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 digital signature using Nettle's low-level ECC API. The signature scheme is based on ECDLP on ГОСТ TC26 curves, which Shor's algorithm solves in polynomial time on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. gost_point_mul_g performs the scalar multiplication core operation of ГОСТ 34.10.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 квантово-уязвим; в переходный период необходима гибридная подпись ГОСТ + ML-DSA-65.

replacements.migration_notes: Гибридная схема: сохранить gostdsa_sign для совместимости, добавить ML-DSA-65 подпись через liboqs.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: гибридная подпись ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 + ML-DSA-65 обязательна в переходный период

functions.name: streebog256_digest
functions.description: Computes a Стрибог-256 hash (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012) using the Nettle library. Provides 128-bit post-quantum preimage security (Grover). Flagged for inventory; acceptable for most use cases. Prefer streebog512 for long-term post-quantum security.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: Стрибог-256 приемлем; для долгосрочной защиты рекомендуется Стрибог-512.

replacements.notes: Для долгосрочной постквантовой защиты использовать Стрибог-512 (streebog512_*).

functions.name: streebog512_digest
functions.description: Computes a Стрибог-512 hash (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012) using the Nettle library. Provides 256-bit post-quantum preimage security (Grover). Quantum-safe. Flagged for inventory only.
functions.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev.5 (256-bit post-quantum security is sufficient)
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: Стрибог-512 является постквантово-стойкой хэш-функцией.

replacements.notes: Стрибог-512 уже является постквантово-стойкой хэш-функцией. Миграция не требуется.

functions.name: gost28147_set_key
functions.description: Sets up or uses the ГОСТ 28147-89 / Магма symmetric cipher in Nettle. 64-bit block, 256-bit key. Grover's algorithm gives ~128-bit effective key security. The 64-bit block size creates a classical birthday attack at 2^32 blocks. Should be replaced by ГОСТ Р 34.12-2015 Кузнечик for new implementations.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ГОСТ 28147-89 (Магма) с 64-битным блоком не рекомендуется для новых применений; следует использовать Кузнечик.

replacements.notes: Заменить ГОСТ 28147-89 (Магма) на Кузнечик (ГОСТ Р 34.12-2015, 128-битный блок).

botan.description: Botan — кроссплатформенная C++ криптографическая библиотека с поддержкой ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012, ГОСТ 28147-89 и Стрибог.

functions.name: GOST_3410_PrivateKey
functions.description: Botan C++ class for ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 (and ГОСТ Р 34.10-2001) ECC key pairs. The security of these keys relies on the ECDLP on ГОСТ TC26 curves, which Shor's algorithm solves in polynomial time. Any code instantiating GOST_3410_PrivateKey or GOST_3410_PublicKey is performing quantum-insecure asymmetric cryptography.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 квантово-уязвим; гибридная схема ГОСТ + ML-DSA-65 обязательна в переходный период.

replacements.migration_notes: Использовать Botan::Dilithium_PrivateKey (Botan 3.x) или ML_DSA_PrivateKey для постквантовой подписи. Гибридная схема: сохранить GOST_3410 + добавить Dilithium.
replacements.tc26_note: ТК 26: гибридная подпись ГОСТ Р 34.10-2012 + ML-DSA-65

functions.name: GOST_28147_MAC
functions.description: Botan C++ class for ГОСТ 28147-89 MAC (имитовставка). 32-bit tag, based on Магма cipher. Same quantum analysis as GCRY_MAC_GOST28147_IMIT: Grover on 256-bit key gives 128-bit security, but 32-bit tag is classically weak and 64-bit block limits security. Should be replaced by HMAC-Стрибог-256.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: имитовставка ГОСТ 28147-89 — устаревший MAC; рекомендуется HMAC-Стрибог-256.

replacements.notes: Заменить GOST_28147_MAC на HMAC с Стрибог-256 или Стрибог-512.

functions.name: GOST_3411
functions.description: Botan C++ class for Стрибог (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012) hash functions. Streebog_256 produces a 256-bit digest (128-bit post-quantum security, borderline); Streebog_512 produces a 512-bit digest (256-bit post-quantum security, acceptable). Flagged for inventory. Prefer Streebog_512 for post-quantum contexts.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: Стрибог (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012) рекомендован; для максимальной постквантовой стойкости предпочтителен Стрибог-512.

replacements.notes: Для долгосрочной постквантовой защиты использовать Стрибог-512 вместо Стрибог-256.

functions.name: GOST_28147
functions.description: Botan C++ class for ГОСТ 28147-89 (Магма) block cipher. 64-bit block, 256-bit key. Grover's algorithm gives ~128-bit effective key security; the 64-bit block is the primary classical concern. Should be replaced by a Grasshopper/Кузнечик implementation for new systems.
functions.tc26_reference: ТК 26: ГОСТ 28147-89 с 64-битным блоком не рекомендуется для новых применений; использовать Кузнечик (ГОСТ Р 34.12-2015).

replacements.notes: Заменить GOST-28147-89 (Магма, 64-бит блок) на Кузнечик/Grasshopper (128-бит блок): Botan::BlockCipher::create("Grasshopper").
